explication: Clowder AI is a platform for turning independent model CLIs into persistent, collaborative agent teams. The principal workflow is: an operator uses the web workspace to request or guide work; the API selects an agent session, dispatches execution, and records review or collaboration state; agents exchange handoffs and produce durable evidence and trajectories that can be replayed or searched later. The tree strongly supports orchestration, review, memory, skills, and governance. Several API and storage links remain intentionally omitted because their implementations were not sampled.
